item.title: Ships of the Shattered Empire brings mass combat to Genesys this Friday
item.description: Ships of the Shattered Empire arrives Jan 9 for Genesys RPG. The 208-page book adds ship profiles and setting-agnostic mass combat rules.

item.title: BMO Jumpers and Bubbline Pins: A look at Forbidden Planet’s new Adventure Time exclusives
item.description: Forbidden Planet has announced a new wave of exclusive Adventure Time merchandise for 2026, featuring BMO jumpers, enamel pins, and more from the Land of Ooo.

item.title: Concept art for real-world “drone fortress” brings Cyberpunk rescue hubs to the Alps
item.description: Architect Alina Sanina unveils the Lynx, a Gothic-futuristic drone station for mountain rescue that looks straight out of a sci-fi roleplaying game.

item.title: Review: Fate Forlorn RPG – Quickstart Edition
item.description: Looking for a gritty new TTRPG? Read our review of the Fate Forlorn Quickstart Edition. Dark art, brutal mechanics, and 136 pages of content - all for free.

item.title: Atlas Games saves university library waste from landfill
item.description: Atlas Games and Replay Workshop have partnered with UMD to recycle hundreds of plastic magazine holders into new tabletop game accessories.

item.title: Watch Sam Rockwell in the off-the-chain trailer for ‘Good Luck, Have Fun, Don’t Die’
item.description: Briarcliff Entertainment has dropped the full trailer for Good Luck, Have Fun, Don’t Die, and it looks like it's going to be an off-the-chain, sci-fi adventure that's funny and definitely a bit weird.

item.title: Why a lead engineer thinks you should treat LEGO’s new Smart Tech as a “layer”, not a toy
item.description: Patrick Faulkner, Lead Engineer at Accu, discusses LEGO's new SMART Play technology, advising on the right age for introduction and its use in prototyping.

item.title: Saving the universe with a cafeteria lady: Inside the Mecha Force Tango RPG
item.description: From 40k grimdark to neon mechs. Oddvoid Productions discusses Mecha Force Tango, their new anime-inspired RPG where support staff save the world.

item.title: Robin D. Laws returns to drama with Page Turners, a duet RPG from Pelgrane Press
item.description: Pelgrane Press has announced release dates for Page Turners, a new duet RPG from Robin D. Laws designed for one player and one GM.

item.title: Routinely Itemised: RPG #343
item.description: Matt Mercer steps back from DMing due to burnout, Steve Dee passes away and Leon Barillaro joins Wizards of the Coast. Plus news on the Nancy Drew RPG and Conpulsion.
